mistvale:threshold.title: Beyond the threshold
mistvale:threshold.objective: Clear Mist Gate inside The Mirrorwell.
mistvale:threshold.conclusion: The first seal opens. The damage reaches deeper than the road, but the anchor can still be restored.

mistvale:anchor.title: Find the reflection that holds the mist anchor
mistvale:anchor.objective: Find the reflection that holds the mist anchor.
mistvale:anchor.conclusion: The anchor answers. A path can change without leaving its travelers behind. Someone must remain to tell the reflection from the road.

choices.label: Mark the honest paths
choices.text: A path can change without leaving its travelers behind.

choices.label: Watch the Mirrorwell
choices.text: Someone must remain to tell the reflection from the road.

mistvale:oath.title: Two duties, one journey
mistvale:oath.objective: Recruit one guardian; leave the other to defend Mistvale.
mistvale:oath.conclusion: One guardian joins the expedition. The other takes the watch. Neither duty can be left undone.

hollow_isles:signs.title: Read the land
hollow_isles:signs.objective: Survey The Nameless Crown and Memory Shore.
hollow_isles:signs.conclusion: The crown is light as driftwood. Every jewel reflects a different face. Footsteps appear in the sand where the lost kingdom’s road once stood.

hollow_isles:supplies.title: A road worth keeping
hollow_isles:supplies.objective: Hollowguard’s archivists need metal clasps to hold the recovered memory tablets.
hollow_isles:supplies.conclusion: The supplies are put to use before you leave. The road is safer for the next traveler.

hollow_isles:road.title: Danger on the approach
hollow_isles:road.objective: Clear the threat at Relic Shore.
hollow_isles:road.conclusion: The watch gathers its wounded and sets the next signal. You have earned the right to carry their trust.

hollow_isles:threshold.title: Beyond the threshold
hollow_isles:threshold.objective: Clear Hollow Gate inside The Lost Kingdom.
hollow_isles:threshold.conclusion: The first seal opens. The damage reaches deeper than the road, but the anchor can still be restored.

hollow_isles:anchor.title: Restore the last throne’s memory
hollow_isles:anchor.conclusion: The anchor answers. A kingdom remembered by everyone cannot vanish again. Then its last throne will serve as a witness, not a ruler.

choices.label: Share the kingdom’s memory
choices.text: A kingdom remembered by everyone cannot vanish again.

choices.label: Guard the last throne
choices.text: Then its last throne will serve as a witness, not a ruler.

hollow_isles:oath.title: Two duties, one journey
hollow_isles:oath.objective: Recruit one guardian; leave the other to defend The Hollow Isles.
hollow_isles:oath.conclusion: One guardian joins the expedition. The other takes the watch. Neither duty can be left undone.

deep:front0.title: The Broken Threshold
deep:front0.objective: Hold this front with three companions who have not fought a previous final front.
deep:front0.conclusion: The threshold holds. The first three companions keep the way open.

deep:front1.title: The World Serpent
deep:front1.objective: Hold this front with three companions who have not fought a previous final front.
deep:front1.conclusion: The World Serpent falls. A second company holds the path to the heart.

deep:front2.title: The Devouring Heart
deep:front2.objective: Hold this front with three companions who have not fought a previous final front.
deep:front2.conclusion: The heart is quiet. Nine companions have held the world together.

ravenwood.name: Springward Cairn
ravenwood.text: Clear water runs beneath the sick roots. Someone has bound the spring with a strip of watch-cloth.

ravenwood.name: Thornwatch Signal
ravenwood.text: A broken watch horn lies beside tracks leading toward the Hollow Oak.

frostpeaks.name: The Unlit Beacon
frostpeaks.text: The beacon is cold, but its wick is new. Its keeper left willingly.

frostpeaks.name: Glacier Names
frostpeaks.text: Names carved into blue ice belong to watchkeepers still living in Icehelm.

stormcrown.name: Windcaller Bell
stormcrown.text: The bell moves without sounding. Its clapper points toward the storm.

stormcrown.name: The Bent Standard
stormcrown.text: A watch standard has bent toward the peak against the wind.

ashen.name: The Ash Gauge
ashen.text: The lava has risen past marks cut by three generations of furnace workers.

ashen.name: Cooling Channel
ashen.text: A cold channel steams with no water in it. The caldera’s pressure is turning inward.

marsh.name: Reedkeeper Post
marsh.text: A basket tied above the water holds the last dry seed from a flooded garden.

marsh.name: The Sinking Shrine
marsh.text: Offerings float upward through a shrine whose floor is sinking.

silvermere.name: The False Light
silvermere.text: A shard of the lighthouse lens catches sunlight from the wrong direction.

silvermere.name: Saltglass Marker
silvermere.text: Salt has sealed a warning scratched into the old keeper’s stone.

eldergrove.name: Seedkeeper Circle
eldergrove.text: Tiny shoots grow inside a ring no animal will cross.

eldergrove.name: The Listening Root
eldergrove.text: The roots tremble when you speak a name, then settle when you listen.

iron_plains.name: The Abandoned Plow
iron_plains.text: A plow was forged from an old spear. Its blade has begun pointing toward the bastion.

iron_plains.name: Siege Survey
iron_plains.text: Every abandoned engine faces the same farm road.

shadowfen.name: The Cold Lantern
shadowfen.text: The lantern flame casts two shadows. Neither belongs to you.

shadowfen.name: Webkeeper Hollow
shadowfen.text: Threads stretched across a hollow carry the voices of missing travelers.

drakeshard.name: The Singing Shard
drakeshard.text: The shard’s note changes when you turn toward the vault.

drakeshard.name: Old Scale Oath
drakeshard.text: A dragon oath is cut into stone beneath a hunter’s later boast.

westreach.name: The Bell Rope
westreach.text: The rope is wet with seawater though the tide cannot reach it.

westreach.name: Wreckers’ Ledger
westreach.text: The ledger lists ships that have not yet sailed.

deadwind.name: The Last Lamp
deadwind.text: A lamp burns beside boots whose owner left no footprints.

deadwind.name: Names in Dust
deadwind.text: The same name is written again and again beneath the dust.

ravenford.name: The Torn Oath
ravenford.text: The oath’s missing line promises service to the people, not the crown.

ravenford.name: The Crownroad Seal
ravenford.text: The seal has split exactly where the royal road leaves the capital.

cursed_mire.name: The Broken Chain
cursed_mire.text: A chain link rings when held above the black water.

cursed_mire.name: Soulwater Cairn
cursed_mire.text: The cairn’s stones bear the marks of armies from opposing sides.

golden.name: The False Horizon
golden.text: The horizon moves with the lens even when the sun stands still.

golden.name: The Buried Lens
golden.text: A second lens is buried facing the first, turning daylight into a closed circle.

dragons_rest.name: The Warm Shell
dragons_rest.text: The shell is warm. A new brood is sleeping under the ash.

dragons_rest.name: The Ashwing Perch
dragons_rest.text: Old scorch marks end around a circle of untouched nesting stone.

mistvale.name: The Wrong Reflection
mistvale.text: Your reflection raises its hand before you do. It points along the path.

mistvale.name: The Returning Ribbon
mistvale.text: A ribbon tied upstream returns on water flowing the other way.

hollow_isles.name: The Nameless Crown
hollow_isles.text: The crown is light as driftwood. Every jewel reflects a different face.

hollow_isles.name: Memory Shore
hollow_isles.text: Footsteps appear in the sand where the lost kingdom’s road once stood.

ravenwood.before: The old forest seals its roads as a blight takes root beneath the Hollow Oak. Lyra Vane asks you to read the signs along the road. Garrick Thornward is preparing the last defenses.
ravenwood.after: The Briar Warden is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: A road is a promise to those who must walk it.
A safe home gives every traveler somewhere to return.

frostpeaks.before: Icehelm’s beacons are disappearing behind a wall of unnatural frost. Vesper asks you to read the signs along the road. Stellan Rimeborn is preparing the last defenses.
frostpeaks.after: The Rime Colossus is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: No beacon matters if we abandon the people below it.
A watch kept through one more night may save the whole valley.

stormcrown.before: The mountain winds carry a voice that calls the watch away from their posts. Thorvald Thunderbrow asks you to read the signs along the road. Eydis Stormweaver is preparing the last defenses.
stormcrown.after: The Tempest Roc is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: Let the storm test us; it must not divide us.
We will put the watch back where the wind can see it.

ashen.before: Ashenreach stands above lava channels that no longer follow the mountain’s will. Ignis asks you to read the signs along the road. Veyra Cindervein is preparing the last defenses.
ashen.after: Inferno-Lord Vulgrim is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: Fire serves people. It should never demand them.
We can hold the mountain, one repaired gate at a time.

marsh.before: The raised timber paths around Wickermoor vanish beneath spreading rot. Morana asks you to read the signs along the road. Odran Fenward is preparing the last defenses.
marsh.after: Mire-Mother Morvana is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: A village is every home we can still reach.
Then we build paths the water cannot take.

silvermere.before: Silverkeep’s lighthouse shines inland, drawing ships toward the rocks. Captain Jora Stormtide asks you to read the signs along the road. Captain Roran Deepwatch is preparing the last defenses.
silvermere.after: The Brine Sovereign is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: The light belongs to everyone who trusts it.
Then no one will turn it against them again.

eldergrove.before: The grove has no city, only ancient paths now guarded by awakened roots. Rhea Fernblade asks you to read the signs along the road. Aven Oakward is preparing the last defenses.
eldergrove.after: The Rootbound Ancient is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: No city owns this place. Its paths must remain open.
And the living heart must remain whole.

iron_plains.before: Farms outside Harrowstead are caught between abandoned engines of war. General Cedric Ironclad asks you to read the signs along the road. Marshal Adela Steelwind is preparing the last defenses.
iron_plains.after: The Iron Revenant is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: We did not win a homeland just to march over it.
The strongest wall is the one that lets the harvest pass.

shadowfen.before: There is no settlement in Shadowfen. Lanterns lead travelers off the safe paths. Iris Nightroot asks you to read the signs along the road. Cael Mossshade is preparing the last defenses.
shadowfen.after: Xylos is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: Leave one honest light and someone will find their way.
I will stay until the false ones go dark.

drakeshard.before: Ironhold’s hunters return with shards that hum in the presence of old dragon bones. Dareth Scalebreaker asks you to read the signs along the road. Kaela Wyrmbound is preparing the last defenses.
drakeshard.after: The Shardwing Tyrant is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: A trophy is worth less than the hunter carrying it.
An oath is worth only what we protect in its name.

westreach.before: A bell beneath Westhaven’s harbor sounds before every wreck. Mira Glasswave asks you to read the signs along the road. Eren Saltwatch is preparing the last defenses.
westreach.after: The Wreck-King is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: Let the harbor earn its living without another wreck.
And let every ship know someone is keeping watch.

deadwind.before: Duskwatch keeps its lamps lit for travelers who no longer cast shadows. Lenna Veilborn asks you to read the signs along the road. Varric Ashwake is preparing the last defenses.
deadwind.after: The Breathless Knight is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: We can remember them without joining them.
Then we carry their names into the morning.

ravenford.before: Ravenford’s banners remain raised while the old crown’s oath slowly unravels. Sir Alistair of Ravenford asks you to read the signs along the road. Dame Elowen Rootsworn is preparing the last defenses.
ravenford.after: The Oathbreaker is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: A road closed to the people is no royal road at all.
Then the oath will name them first.

cursed_mire.before: No city stands here. The mire remembers every army that failed to cross it. Malakor asks you to read the signs along the road. Sereth Veilkeeper is preparing the last defenses.
cursed_mire.after: Golgotha is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: No more armies should be fed to this place.
We will remember why the crossing must be guarded.

golden.before: Sunspire’s observatory projects roads through the dunes that vanish by morning. Zephyr asks you to read the signs along the road. Samira Dawnwatch is preparing the last defenses.
golden.after: The Glass Serpent is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: A true horizon gives everyone a direction.
And a guarded lens keeps it true.

dragons_rest.before: Cinderport watches the roost above the Ember Coast as ash falls from a clear sky. Ignacia asks you to read the signs along the road. Tavian Ashsail is preparing the last defenses.
dragons_rest.after: The Cinder Matriarch is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: People and dragons can share a coast without sharing a war.
Then we guard the places where that peace begins.

mistvale.before: Mistvale’s paths now return travelers to places they have never visited. Sorrel Mistwalker asks you to read the signs along the road. Orien Reedward is preparing the last defenses.
mistvale.after: The Mirror Hart is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: A path can change without leaving its travelers behind.
Someone must remain to tell the reflection from the road.

hollow_isles.before: Hollowguard stands among relics of a kingdom erased from the living maps. Maera Tideveil asks you to read the signs along the road. Thane Relicward is preparing the last defenses.
hollow_isles.after: The Hollow Monarch is defeated. The anchor is steady, but the roads and the people still need help.
voices: A kingdom remembered by everyone cannot vanish again.
Then its last throne will serve as a witness, not a ruler.
